{"id":1766565576,"question_id":72,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months, 1 week","timestamp":1757545479,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1766565576/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Edit Distance","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int solve(string &word1 , string &word2 , int i , int j)\n    {\n        //base case\n        //word1 is smaller and has finished \n        if(i >= word1.size())\n        {\n            return word2.size() - j;\n        }\n        //word2 is smaller and has finished\n        if(j >= word2.size())\n        {\n            return word1.size() - i;\n;        }\n\n        //ek case hum solve karenge \n        int ans = 0;\n\n        if(word1[i] == word2[j])\n        {\n            //means matching characters appear ->then simply move ahead and check other characters\n            ans = 0 + solve(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j+1); \n        }\n        else\n        {\n            //means the characters didnt match -> then do the operations needed\n            int insertion = 1 + solve(word1 , word2 , i , j+1);\n            int deletion = 1 + solve(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j);\n            int replacement = 1 + solve(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j+1);\n\n            ans = min(insertion , min(deletion , replacement));\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n    int minDistance(string word1, string word2) {\n       return solve(word1 , word2 , 0 , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"edit-distance","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":776}
